# connection

```go
import "banyan/connection"
```

Package connection provides peer connection tracking and management for the Banyan network. It maintains connection state, handles peer lookups via DHT and GossipSub, and manages HTTP capability testing for bidirectional communication.

The package tracks peer connection types \(manual, gossip lookup, HTTP verified, background\), manages unique peer aliases for easy reference, and provides methods for connecting to peers using multiple discovery mechanisms.

<a name="Manager"></a>
## type [Manager](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/connection/manager.go#L38-L51>)

Manager handles peer connection tracking, discovery, and HTTP capability testing. It maintains a registry of tracked peers with their connection status, aliases, and service keys. The manager supports multiple connection types and provides DHT and GossipSub\-based peer lookup functionality.

<a name="Manager.AddTrackedPeer"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [AddTrackedPeer](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/connection/manager.go#L81>)

```go
func (m *Manager) AddTrackedPeer(peerID peer.ID, options types.PeerOptions) *types.ConnectionItem
```

AddTrackedPeer adds a peer to the connection tracking registry or updates an existing peer entry. The options parameter specifies the connection type, HTTP capability, and optional service key. Returns the connection item.

<a name="Manager.CleanupOldConnections"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [CleanupOldConnections](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/connection/manager.go#L240>)

```go
func (m *Manager) CleanupOldConnections()
```

CleanupOldConnections removes disconnected peers that have been offline for more than 30 minutes. Frees up alias slots for reuse.

<a name="Manager.ConnectToPeer"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [ConnectToPeer](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/connection/manager.go#L325>)

```go
func (m *Manager) ConnectToPeer(peerID peer.ID) error
```

ConnectToPeer attempts to connect to a peer using DHT lookup first, falling back to GossipSub\-based peer discovery if DHT fails or is unavailable. Returns nil if already connected or if lookup initiated.

<a name="Manager.ConnectToRequesterDirectly"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [ConnectToRequesterDirectly](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/connection/manager.go#L464>)

```go
func (m *Manager) ConnectToRequesterDirectly(peerID peer.ID, addresses []string)
```

ConnectToRequesterDirectly attempts to establish a direct connection to a peer using a list of provided multiaddresses. Validates peer ID matches and attempts each address until a successful connection is made.

### func \(\*Manager\) [CreateBidirectionalConnection](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/connection/manager.go#L615>)

```go
func (m *Manager) CreateBidirectionalConnection(peerID peer.ID)
```

CreateBidirectionalConnection tests bidirectional HTTP connectivity with a specific peer. Skips testing if already successfully tested within the last 30 seconds.

### func \(\*Manager\) [CreateBidirectionalConnections](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/connection/manager.go#L593>)

```go
func (m *Manager) CreateBidirectionalConnections()
```

CreateBidirectionalConnections tests bidirectional HTTP connectivity with all tracked HTTP\-capable peers. Each test runs concurrently in a goroutine.

<a name="Manager.HandleNewConnection"></a>

```go
func (m *Manager) HandleNewConnection(peerID peer.ID)
```

HandleNewConnection processes a new incoming connection from a peer. Updates connection status and initiates bidirectional HTTP testing for HTTP\-capable or manually added peers.

<a name="Manager.LookupPeer"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [LookupPeer](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/connection/manager.go#L370>)

```go
func (m *Manager) LookupPeer(targetPeerID string, includeFrom bool) error
```

LookupPeer searches for a peer by publishing a lookup request to the gossip network and optionally performing a DHT lookup in parallel. If includeFrom is true, the request includes the sender's peer ID and addresses to allow direct responses.

MarkHTTPTestResult records the HTTP capability test result for a peer. Valid results include HTTPTestSuccess, HTTPTestFailed, and HTTPTestPending.

<a name="Manager.MarkPeerHTTPCapable"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [MarkPeerHTTPCapable](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/connection/manager.go#L195>)

```go
func (m *Manager) MarkPeerHTTPCapable(peerID peer.ID, bidirectional bool)
```

MarkPeerHTTPCapable marks a peer as HTTP capable with optional bidirectional support. Updates the peer's HTTP test result to success and records the test timestamp.

<a name="Manager.TestPeerHTTPCapability"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [TestPeerHTTPCapability](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/connection/manager.go#L656>)

```go
func (m *Manager) TestPeerHTTPCapability(peerID peer.ID)
```

TestPeerHTTPCapability tests whether a peer has an HTTP server by sending a ping request via libp2p HTTP transport. Marks the peer as HTTP capable if the test succeeds.
